Face crops of public-domain and CC0 portraits whose Commons category states an age from 20 to 25.
The portraits are clothed or neutral. The age is the category age, not an estimate.
Each file is that portrait's face, with a margin around the box.
Swimwear, duplicate frames of the same photograph, and a misfiled medical photograph are not included.
